plugin.name: OSF Settings
plugin.description: Configure Transit Report in OSF Settings. Requires OSF Settings. Preserves existing OSF preferences and installs no game settings/menu replacements.

plugin.name: Gameplay Options (standalone)
plugin.description: Configure Transit Report directly inside Gameplay Options. Does not require OSF Settings or OSF UI. Test branch: installs settings-panel replacements only. Does not replace the main-menu or pause-menu SWFs. Other settings-panel replacements may conflict.

plugin.name: Neither - configure in installer
plugin.description: Choose all Transit Report settings on the following installer pages. Adds no OSF Settings entry and no Gameplay Options controls. Reinstall with Replace to change choices or switch settings backends. Previous menu preferences are ignored in this mode.
